evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Establishing a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to stability/readiness (conservation) and to maintaining capability (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Framing unpracticed rollback as not having it at all appeals to capability as the measure of possession.
Recording the cadence as a key decision restates the conservation and competence appeal; principal is Quinton, reported through Xena's rendering.
Assigning ownership names who is accountable for maintaining the capability, appealing to competence as the good.
